title: China sanctions US companies over military sales, aid to Taiwan, will it impact Washington?
description: China has decided to put sanctions on US companies after Washington decided to sale weapons to Taiwan. Earlier, Joe Biden had approved military assistance to Taiwan.

title: China sanctions US-linked companies over arms sales to Taiwan
description: The US recently approved $571.3 million in defence support for Taiwan, after giving the go-ahead to arms sales worth an estimated $385 million.

title: China imposes sanctions on military companies, executives over U.S. arms sales to Taiwan
description: Boeing subsidiary Insitu Inc., RTX Inc.’s Raytheon Canada and Raytheon Australia, as well as Hudson Technologies Co. are among the companies listed by China’s foreign ministry

title: Taiwan’s presidential office runs first ‘tabletop’ simulation of Chinese military escalation
description: Taiwan’s presidential office held a “tabletop” exercise on Thursday simulating military escalations by China, a first-of-its-kind drill involving government agencies beyond the armed forces that highlights Taipei’s urgency in ensuring preparedness against an increasingly assertive Beijing.

title: In a first, Taiwan’s Presidential Office runs war games to simulate a China emergency
description: Dozens of central and local government agencies as well as civil groups participated in the 3-hour exercise on Thursday, the sources said.

title: Zero Day: Taiwan TV Drama Dares to Tackle Chinese Invasion Scenario
description: The Taiwan TV drama 'Zero Day' portrays a Chinese invasion, challenging the Taiwanese film industry's constraints due to China's influence. The show highlights military tensions, exposing the pressure on artists who fear repercussions from China. The series aims to raise awareness on China's threats to Taiwan.

title: China says US is ‘playing with fire’ after latest military aid for Taiwan
description: A Chinese Foreign Ministry statement urged the US to stop arming Taiwan and stop what it called “dangerous moves that undermine peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait.”

title: China says US is 'playing with fire' after latest military aid for Taiwan
description: BEIJING (AP) — The Chinese government protested Sunday the latest American announcements of military sales and assistance to Taiwan, warning the United States that it is “playing with fire.”

title: China says US ‘playing with fire’ after latest military aid for Taiwan
description: The US has remained steadfast to its pledge for military aid, education and supplies for Taiwan.

title: Taiwan Boosts Defense with M1A2T Abrams Tanks amid Rising Tensions
description: Taiwan has received 38 M1A2T Abrams tanks from the United States, the first such delivery in 23 years. This is part of a larger 122-tank order amidst growing tensions with China. The advanced tanks are seen as crucial to Taiwan's defense, despite concerns about their suitability for the region's terrain.
